name: AgentMail x402 API
description: Email inbox and messaging API for creating inboxes, listing messages, sending email, replying, and fetching attachments.
use_when: Use when the user wants an AI assistant to work with email inboxes or messages.
how_to_call: If you are using BRIJ Wallet MCP, read openapi_url, build the target URL from x402.http_base_url plus the OpenAPI path, then call the BRIJ MCP tool call_paid_api_endpoint.
